description: Turns a research question into a validated, deploy-ready survey: a short intake, the right instrument for what's being measured (SEQ, SUS, UMUX-Lite, SUPR-Q, NPS, CSAT, CES, PSSUQ, or a custom item set), and a platform-native file for Qualtrics, Typeform, or an in-app survey. Trigger when someone says "I need to survey users about X," "what should I ask users after they do Y," "build me an NPS survey," "help me measure usability of Z," or pastes a vague research need and wants it turned into an actual instrument. Entry point 1 of the research loop (see research-loop).
